title: Retail purchases documentation generation
draft_notice: Generated draft. Human approval required before publication.

source_files.name: purchases.csv
source_files.grain: One row per synthetic retail purchase event.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Synthetic customer identifier used for joins.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Synthetic product identifier used for joins.

columns.name: ingest_ts
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the record is available for ingestion.

columns.name: store_id
columns.description: Store identifier carried into the Sales table.

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Retail sales channel such as store, online, or pickup.

columns.name: synthetic_record
columns.description: Safety marker with the constant value SYNTHETIC.

columns.name: anomaly_label
columns.description: Injected quality label used by the scenario notebooks.

source_files.name: customers.csv
source_files.grain: One row per synthetic retail customer.

columns.name: home_region
columns.description: Synthetic home region for the customer.

columns.name: synthetic_record
columns.description: Safety marker with the constant value SYNTHETIC.

source_files.name: products.csv
source_files.grain: One row per synthetic retail product.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: String flag converted to a boolean in Silver.

columns.name: synthetic_record
columns.description: Safety marker with the constant value SYNTHETIC.

pipeline.name: retail-medallion.DataPipeline
pipeline.execution_pattern: No schedule is committed in source control; workspace orchestration supplies invocation.

notebooks.name: 01_bronze_ingestion
notebooks.purpose: Reads purchases.csv, customers.csv, and products.csv from the retail-purchases landing area and writes Bronze raw tables plus audit metadata.

notebooks.name: 02_silver_transform
notebooks.purpose: Deduplicates purchases, applies anomaly handling, joins customer and product context, and writes Silver tables plus quarantine output.

notebooks.name: 03_gold_aggregations
notebooks.purpose: Publishes Gold Date, Customer, Product, Sales, and sales_monthly_summary tables for Direct Lake consumption.

tables.name: bronze.retail_purchases_raw
tables.purpose: Raw purchase landing table with ingestion metadata.

tables.name: silver.retail_sales_enriched
tables.purpose: Purchase-level Silver sales table with calculated revenue, cost, and gross margin.
quality_rules: customer_key and product_key are present for valid rows

tables.name: silver.retail_purchases_quarantine
tables.purpose: Quarantined purchase rows from deduplication, anomaly, and referential checks.

tables.name: gold.Date
tables.purpose: Calendar dimension published from retail purchase dates.

tables.name: gold.Customer
tables.purpose: Customer dimension used by the RetailSales semantic model.

tables.name: gold.Product
tables.purpose: Product dimension used by the RetailSales semantic model.

tables.name: gold.Sales
tables.purpose: Curated Sales fact table consumed directly by the semantic model.
quality_rules: revenue and cost reconcile to Silver calculations

tables.name: gold.sales_monthly_summary
tables.purpose: Monthly by-channel summary table produced alongside the semantic-model sources.
quality_rules: gross_margin_pct is populated when total_revenue is nonzero

notes: The committed pipeline definition contains explicit failure activities for Bronze, Silver, and Gold stages.
The semantic model consumes four Gold tables only; gold.sales_monthly_summary is a supplemental analytics artifact.
